stories.headline: B.C. rural diversification funding remains open through November 20
stories.body: British Columbia’s fifth Rural Economic Diversification and Infrastructure Program intake closes November 20. Rural and remote communities, First Nations and eligible nonprofits can apply for work that strengthens local economies.

featuredResource.title: Business and Market Responses to the Loss of Low-Grade Wood Markets in the United States
featuredResource.description: This online research report examines business and market responses when outlets for low-grade wood disappear. Its comparisons of processors, cooperative approaches, institutional demand and residual markets help readers assess replacement-market options and their operating constraints.
